races.name: Human
races.desc: Ras seimbang tanpa kelemahan berarti. Adaptif.
races.passive: Adaptable: +5% EXP dari semua sumber

races.name: Beastkin
races.desc: Manusia dengan ciri binatang. Cepat dan kuat.
races.passive: Beast Instinct: +10% crit damage, radar sense

races.name: Demon
races.desc: Makhluk dari dunia bawah. Sangat kuat namun rentan cahaya.
races.passive: Dark Embrace: Dark magic +20%, Light resistance -30%

races.name: Dragon
races.desc: Naga kuno. Kekuatan dominan. Sangat jarang.
races.passive: Dragon Scales: -25% physical damage taken

races.name: Skeleton
races.desc: Rangka hidup. Tidak butuh makanan atau udara.
races.passive: Undying: Immune to poison, +50% damage vs living

races.name: Zombie
races.desc: Mayat hidup. Lambat tapi tahan banting.
races.passive: Rotten Flesh: +20% HP regen, slow movement

races.name: Slime
races.desc: Makhluk lendir. Bisa menyerap elemen.
races.passive: Absorb: Dapat menyerap elemen dari serangan

races.name: Spider
races.desc: Arakhnida. Ahli racun dan jaring.
races.passive: Web Master: +30% poison damage, trap expert

races.name: Goblin
races.desc: Kecil, cerdik, banyak akal. Lemah tapi licik.
races.passive: Sneaky: +15% loot, merchant discount 10%

races.name: Orc
races.desc: Prajurit kasar. Kuat dan brutal.
races.passive: Bloodrage: +20% damage saat HP < 50%

races.name: Elf
races.desc: Panjang umur, gesit, terhubung alam.
races.passive: Nature Bond: +10% bow damage, +5% gather yield

races.name: Dark Elf
races.desc: Elf yang jatuh ke kegelapan. Ahli sihir gelap.
races.passive: Shadow Magic: Dark spells +25%, +10% stealth

races.name: Dwarf
races.desc: Pendek tapi kokoh. Ahli tempa.
races.passive: Master Smith: +25% crafting success, +15% mining

races.name: Vampire
races.desc: Bangsawan malam. Kuat, cepat, mematikan.
races.passive: Blood Drain: Serangan memulihkan 15% HP

races.name: Werewolf
races.desc: Manusia serigala. Bertransformasi saat bulan penuh.
races.passive: Moon Rage: +30% damage saat malam

races.name: Lizardman
races.desc: Manusia kadal dari rawa. Tahan racun.
races.passive: Reptile Hide: -20% poison damage, +15% water affinity

races.name: Mermaid
races.desc: Penduduk laut. Bernyanyi untuk memikat.
races.passive: Song of Sea: Charm enemies 10% chance

races.name: Fairy
races.desc: Peri kecil bersayap. Sihir alam murni.
races.passive: Fairy Dust: +15% magic damage, flight in combat

races.name: Golem
races.desc: Konstruksi batu. Hampir tak bisa dihancurkan.
races.passive: Stone Body: -40% physical damage, immune to knockback

races.name: Spirit
races.desc: Roh murni. Bisa melewati dinding.
races.passive: Ethereal: Physical attacks 50% miss

races.name: Angel
races.desc: Utusan surga. Cahaya murni.
races.passive: Holy Grace: Heal allies 5% per turn, light magic +30%

races.name: Fallen Angel
races.desc: Malaikat yang jatuh. Kekuatan gelap-cahaya.
races.passive: Rebel's Wrath: Hybrid light+dark damage

races.name: Giant
races.desc: Raksasa dari pegunungan. Kekuatan luar biasa.
races.passive: Titan's Grip: 2H weapons +30% damage

races.name: Kobold
races.desc: Kecil, gesit, penakut tapi licik.
races.passive: Trap Sense: Detect traps automatically

races.name: Harpy
races.desc: Setengah burung. Terbang dan menyerang dari udara.
races.passive: Flight: +30% dodge vs melee

races.name: Centaur
races.desc: Setengah kuda. Cepat dan pemanah handal.
races.passive: Swift Hooves: +20% speed, bow damage +15%

races.name: Minotaur
races.desc: Banteng manusia. Kuat dan buas.
races.passive: Labyrinth Sense: Never get lost in dungeons

races.name: Griffin
races.desc: Setengah elang, setengah singa. Raja langit.
races.passive: Aerial Superiority: +40% damage from air, wind magic +20%

races.name: Phoenix
races.desc: Burung api abadi. Bangkit dari kematian.
races.passive: Rebirth: Revive once per battle with 50% HP

races.name: Ancient Dragon
races.desc: Naga dari awal waktu. Kekuatan tak terbatas.
races.passive: Eternal: Immune to instant death, all elements +15%

races.name: Titan
races.desc: Ras raksasa kuno. Kekuatan dunia.
races.passive: Worldshaker: Ground attacks AoE, +30% damage vs boss

races.name: Naga
races.desc: Ular raksasa suci. Sihir dan kekuatan.
races.passive: Serpent Coil: 20% chance to stun with any attack

races.name: Kitsune
races.desc: Rubah ekor sembilan. Master ilusi.
races.passive: Illusion: 25% chance enemy attacks miss entirely

races.name: Oni
races.desc: Iblis jepang. Kuat dan haus darah.
races.passive: Bloodlust: +1% damage per 1% HP missing

races.name: Dryad
races.desc: Roh pohon. Sihir alam dan regenerasi.
races.passive: Root Network: +3% HP regen per turn in nature
